cards.ex: The company had to undergo restructuring to stay competitive in the market.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya bozorda raqobatbardosh bo'lish uchun qayta tuzilishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tashkilot yoki tizimning ichki tuzilishini o'zgartirish, qayta tashkil etish.

cards.ex: The government is planning to implement changes to the tax system next year.
cards.exUz: Hukumat kelgusi yilda soliq tizimiga o'zgarishlar kiritishni rejalashtirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Rejalashtirilgan o'zgarishlarni amalda qo'llash, hayotga tadbiq etish.

cards.ex: To stay ahead, businesses must embrace innovation and adapt to new technologies.
cards.exUz: O'z o'rnini saqlab qolish uchun, biznes yangiliklarni qabul qilishi va yangi texnologiyalarga moslashishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi g'oyalar, usullar va texnologiyalarni qo'llab-quvvatlash va ishlatish.

cards.ex: The entire department needed a wholesale change in its operational procedures.
cards.exUz: Butun bo'limning operatsion tartiblarida tub o'zgarish talab etiladi.
cards.uzDef: To'liq va keng qamrovli o'zgarish, barcha sohalarni qamrab oluvchi o'zgarish.

cards.ex: The artist decided to break with tradition and create completely abstract paintings.
cards.exUz: Rassom an'anadan voz kechib, butunlay mavhum rasmlar yaratishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Eski odatlardan, an'analardan voz kechish, yangi yo'lni tanlash.

cards.ex: The new software is still in the fine-tuning process, but it's showing great promise.
cards.exUz: Yangi dastur hali sozlash jarayonida, ammo u juda katta umid uyg'otmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jarayon yoki tizimni mukammallashtirish uchun kichik o'zgartirishlar kiritish.

cards.ex: The company had to alter course when the market conditions changed unexpectedly.
cards.exUz: Bozor sharoitlari kutilmaganda o'zgarganida kompaniya yo'nalishni o'zgartirishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Reja, usul yoki yo'nalishni o'zgartirish, boshqa yo'nalishga burilish.

cards.ex: The country needs a sweeping reform of its healthcare system.
cards.exUz: Mamlakatga sog'liqni saqlash tizimini keng isloh qilish kerak.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va muhim o'zgarishlar, keng qamrovli islohotlar.

cards.ex: The invention of the internet ushered in a new era of communication.
cards.exUz: Internetning ixtirosi aloqa sohasida yangi davrni boshlab berdi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi davr, usul yoki o'zgarishning boshlanishiga sabab bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The CEO decided to recast the role of middle management to improve efficiency.
cards.exUz: Bosh direktor samaradorlikni oshirish uchun o'rta menejment rolini o'zgartirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Vazifa, rol yoki funktsiyani yangicha talqin qilish, o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: There's been a gradual shift in public opinion towards environmental issues.
cards.exUz: Jamoatchilik fikrida atrof-muhit muammolariga nisbatan asta-sekin o'zgarish bo'lmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Sekin-asta va sezilarli darajada bo'lmagan o'zgarish, bosqichma-bosqich siljish.

cards.ex: The economic crisis acted as a catalyst for change in the political landscape.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy inqiroz siyosiy vaziyatda o'zgarishlar katalizatori bo'lib xizmat qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishni tezlashtiradigan yoki unga sabab bo'ladigan omil.

cards.ex: Even when challenged, she stuck to her guns and defended her proposal.
cards.exUz: U bahslashgan taqdirda ham, o'z fikrida qat'iy turdi va taklifini himoya qildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrida qat'iy turish, o'z pozitsiyasidan voz kechmaslik.

cards.ex: We need to revisit the issue of funding before making a final decision.
cards.exUz: Yakuniy qaror qabul qilishdan oldin moliyalashtirish masalasini qayta ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni yana bir bor ko'rib chiqish, unga qayta nazar tashlash.

cards.ex: In this business, you have to roll with the punches and adapt to unexpected challenges.
cards.exUz: Bu biznesda siz vaziyatga moslashishingiz va kutilmagan qiyinchiliklarga bardosh berishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatlarda ham o'zgarishlarga moslashish, bardosh berish.

cards.ex: The company is known for pushing the envelope in terms of product design.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya mahsulot dizayni bo'yicha chegarani kengaytirishga urinishi bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud chegaralarni kengaytirishga harakat qilish, yangi narsalarni sinab ko'rish.

cards.ex: The new policy set the stage for significant economic growth.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat sezilarli iqtisodiy o'sish uchun sharoit yaratdi.
cards.uzDef: Keyingi voqea yoki o'zgarish uchun sharoit yaratmoq, imkoniyat yaratmoq.

cards.ex: It's difficult to get a new business off the ground without sufficient funding.
cards.exUz: Yetarli mablag'siz yangi biznesni ishga tushirish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Yangi loyiha yoki biznesni ishga tushirish, amalga oshirish.

cards.ex: He often goes against the grain, which makes him a valuable member of the team.
cards.exUz: U ko'pincha oqimga qarshi boradi, bu esa uni jamoaning qimmatli a'zosiga aylantiradi.
cards.uzDef: Umumiy fikrga yoki odatiy yo'nalishga qarshi harakat qilish.

cards.ex: We need to recalibrate expectations after the project fell behind schedule.
cards.exUz: Loyiha jadvaldan orqada qolgandan so'ng, biz umidni qayta baholashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan natijalarni o'zgartirish, real sharoitga moslashtirish.

cards.ex: This new policy is a step in the right direction towards environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Ushbu yangi siyosat atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish yo'nalishida to'g'ri qadamdir.
cards.term: a step in the right direction
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yaxshilashga qaratilgan ijobiy harakat.

cards.ex: He rose through the ranks from a junior employee to become the CEO.
cards.exUz: U oddiy xodimdan bosh direktor lavozimiga qadar martabada ko'tarildi.
cards.uzDef: Past lavozimdan boshlab, martabada yuqoriga ko'tarilish.

cards.ex: The new CEO was brought in to shake up the status quo and improve performance.
cards.exUz: Yangi bosh direktor vaziyatni o'zgartirish va faoliyatni yaxshilash uchun olib kelingan.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaziyatni o'zgartirish, notinchlik keltirib chiqarish.

cards.ex: Businesses must adapt and evolve to survive in today's competitive market.
cards.exUz: Bugungi raqobatbardosh bozorda omon qolish uchun biznes moslashishi va rivojlanishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zgaruvchan sharoitlarga moslashish va rivojlanishda davom etish.

cards.ex: To succeed in this industry, you need to be open to change and new ideas.
cards.exUz: Bu sohada muvaffaqiyat qozonish uchun siz o'zgarishga va yangi g'oyalarga ochiq bo'lishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'zgarishlarni qabul qilishga va ularga moslashishga tayyor bo'lish.

cards.ex: The political situation is in a state of flux after the recent elections.
cards.exUz: So'nggi saylovlardan so'ng siyosiy vaziyat o'zgarish holatida.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy o'zgarishda bo'lgan, beqaror holatda.

cards.ex: There's been a cultural shift towards greater environmental awareness.
cards.exUz: Atrof-muhit haqida ko'proq xabardorlikka qaratilgan madaniy o'zgarish bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning qadriyatlari, e'tiqodlari va xulq-atvorida sezilarli o'zgarish.

cards.ex: The company decided to shift the focus to developing new products.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya diqqatni yangi mahsulotlar ishlab chiqishga qaratishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Diqqatni bir narsadan boshqa narsaga o'zgartirish, e'tiborni boshqa narsaga qaratish.

cards.ex: There are some exciting changes on the horizon for our company.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamiz uchun yaqin orada ba'zi hayajonli o'zgarishlar kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tez orada sodir bo'ladigan yoki paydo bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: The new technology is rewriting the rules of the industry.
cards.exUz: Yangi texnologiya sanoat qoidalarini qayta yozmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qoidalarni tubdan o'zgartirish, yangi qoidalar yaratish.
